title: Record stable failure reasons for blocked delivery items
problem: Operators currently reconstruct blocked delivery state from scattered logs, which makes recovery slow and encourages unsafe blind retries.

in: Add a stable failure code to blocking scheduler outcomes
Persist the reason in the event log
Expose the next action to the tracker and retrying agent
out: Infer failures from natural-language agent reports

behavior: When an item cannot advance, MergeWave records a stable code, severity, retryability, evidence references, human explanation, and actionable next step. A blocking failure prevents dependent dispatch until reconciliation observes a safe new state.

technical_context.summary: The classifier consumes normalized external observations after workspace and delivery checks.
constraints: Do not put provider names in core failure codes
Do not treat agent self-report as authority

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A stale CI observation produces stale_ci and prevents release.
Every blocking failure contains a code, explanation, and suggested action.

test_scenarios.given: CI is green for an older pull-request head
test_scenarios.when: The delivery gate evaluates the current head
test_scenarios.then: The item remains blocked with stale_ci

risk.reason: Incorrect classification can delay delivery or allow an unsafe retry.

rollout.strategy: Enable after the simulator contract tests pass.
rollout.kill_switch: Fall back to blocking on unknown observations.
